name: spacegame
description: spacegame demo 1, round 6: you wake without the suit, find it, and the one AI comes up; a task market of robots that bid, a ground hauler that finds its way and is lifted when stuck, queue-anything, stockpiles and a ledger you place from; a 2 MW reactor and a pulse laser limited by its heat sink, kerfs that free blocks, ablation, fists; composition fields with uncertainty, an assay station, a modular shaft rig, planned supports and collapse; a wreck of real parts you walk into, needs, fog of war, wires. One page, three.js
